panels.title: Do you keep making the same mistakes?

options.content: **Choose a player at the top to begin.** Stockfish checks every move of each recent game (the last 60 days by default). A move is an **error** when it drops your winning chances by 10+ points (inaccuracy), 20+ (mistake) or 30+ (blunder). **Positional** errors lose ground without losing material; **tactical** ones allow or miss a combination. The three tables at the top cover all analysed games, whatever the date range or mode; the charts below follow the filters. **Position** opens the position on Lichess.

panels.title: Games analysed
panels.description: Standard games inside the analyser's window (ANALYSIS_DAYS, 60 by default) for the selected players. Games analysed earlier stay on the dashboard after they leave the window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(analysed_in_window) || ' / ' || sum(games_in_window) AS analysed
          FROM dashboard.analysis_status WHERE username IN (${player:sqlstring})

panels.title: Average accuracy
panels.description: Stockfish accuracy (Lichess's formula) over analysed games matching the filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(stockfish_accuracy) AS accuracy FROM dashboard.recent_games
          WHERE rated AND username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND rules = 'chess'

SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_error) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS errors
          FROM dashboard.player_moves WHERE rated AND username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)

SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'positional') / nullif(count(*), 0) AS positional
          FROM dashboard.errors WHERE rated AND username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)

panels.title: Same position, same mistake
panels.description: The same bad move in the same exact position, in two or more games. Avg drop is in winning-chance points.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS "Player", opening AS "Opening",
          move_number || CASE WHEN colour = 'white' THEN '. ' ELSE '... ' END || your_move AS "You play", engine_move AS "Engine prefers",
          times_played AS "Times", avg_win_loss AS "Avg drop", usual_kind AS "Type",
          'https://lichess.org/analysis/' || replace(fen, ' ', '_') || '?color=' || colour AS "Position", latest_game AS "Game"
          FROM dashboard.repeated_mistakes WHERE username IN (${player:sqlstring})
          ORDER BY times_played * avg_win_loss DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Positions you keep reaching and misplaying
panels.description: Positions reached in 3+ games where at least one move went wrong, including different wrong moves.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS "Player", opening AS "Opening",
          move_number || CASE WHEN colour = 'white' THEN '. ' ELSE '... ' END || usual_move AS "Usual move", engine_move AS "Engine prefers", games AS "Games",
          errors AS "Errors", error_rate AS "Error %", avg_win_loss AS "Avg drop", 'https://lichess.org/analysis/' || replace(fen, ' ', '_') || '?color=' || colour AS "Position"
          FROM dashboard.repeated_positions WHERE username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND errors > 0
          ORDER BY errors DESC, games DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Pawn structures where you go wrong
panels.description: After move 10. Same pawns on both sides and kings on the same wings, in 3+ games. Game links the worst error.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS "Player", colour AS "Colour", structure AS "Structure",
          games AS "Games", errors AS "Errors", positional_errors AS "Positional", tactical_errors AS "Tactical",
          error_rate AS "Error %", opening AS "Opening", worst_game AS "Game"
          FROM dashboard.structure_mistakes WHERE username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND errors > 0
          ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT name AS "Player",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'positional') AS "Positional",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'allowed_tactic') AS "Allowed a tactic",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'missed_tactic') AS "Missed a tactic"
          FROM dashboard.errors WHERE rated AND username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) GROUP BY name ORDER BY name

panels.title: Errors per 100 moves by clock
panels.description: Time left on your clock after the move.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name || ' / ' || clock_bucket || ' left' AS "Player / clock",
          round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_error) / count(*), 1) AS "Errors per 100 moves"
          FROM dashboard.player_moves WHERE rated AND username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND clock_bucket IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY name, clock_bucket ORDER BY name, min(array_position(ARRAY['3min+', '1-3min', '30-60s', '10-30s', '0-10s'], clock_bucket))

SELECT name || ' / ' || phase AS "Player / phase",
          round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_error) / count(*), 1) AS "Errors per 100 moves",
          round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'positional') / count(*), 1) AS "Positional"
          FROM dashboard.player_moves WHERE rated AND username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)
          GROUP BY name, phase ORDER BY name, min(array_position(ARRAY['opening', 'middlegame', 'endgame'], phase))

panels.title: Worst openings (5+ games)
panels.description: Chess.com's opening name for each game.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name || ' / ' || opening AS "Player / opening",
          round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_error)::numeric / count(DISTINCT game_id), 1) AS "Errors per game"
          FROM dashboard.player_moves WHERE rated AND username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND opening IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY name, opening HAVING count(DISTINCT game_id) >= 5
          ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Recent games
panels.description: Accuracy is worked out from our Stockfish analysis (Lichess's formula) and appears once a game is analysed. Chess.com accuracy appears only when someone ran Game Review. The two use different formulas, so compare like with like.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS "Completed", name AS "Player", mode AS "Mode", colour AS "Colour",
          opponent AS "Opponent", outcome AS "Result", rating AS "Rating", opening AS "Opening",
          stockfish_accuracy AS "Accuracy", chesscom_accuracy AS "Chess.com accuracy",
          blunders AS "Blunders", mistakes AS "Mistakes", url AS "Game"
          FROM dashboard.recent_games WHERE rated AND username IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND mode IN (${mode:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND rules = 'chess' ORDER BY ended_at DESC LIMIT 50

list.name: player
list.label: Player
list.query:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (SELECT 0 AS sort, 'Choose a player' AS __text, '-' AS __value
             UNION ALL SELECT 1, name, username FROM dashboard.players) p ORDER BY sort, __text
